title: phlomoides macrophylla
intro: Phlomoides macrophylla, commonly known as Chinese Lizard Tail, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlomoides macrophylla include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
